_comment: Leader behaviour against SCRIPTED sub-agents (fake_subagents.py; see README-leader-fake.md). lf-unprompted asks about this host and names no sub-agent: it measures whether the leader delegates by itself. The four others put the evidence on a host only the investigator can reach (batch-02), so the leader can neither find nor refute it with its own tools. Run with bench.py --fake <url>. summariser, helper and linux_admin are faked with no script.
